observation.command:
rm -f /tmp/pulls3.log
setsid nohup bash -c '
for img in gresau/localstack-persist:4 axllent/mailpit:v1.29.3 darthsim/imgproxy:latest python:3.12-alpine nginx:alpine; do
  echo ">>> pulling $img"
  docker pull "$img" 2>&1 | tail -1
done
echo "ALL_PULLS_DONE"
' > /tmp/pulls3.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &
echo "pulls pid $!"
